assertions.title: Browser push subscription lifecycle persists and can be removed

steps.action: Check push capability matrix and attempt push lifecycle checks
steps.expected: With VAPID configured, push capability true and full lifecycle testable
steps.observed: GET notifications returned capabilities.push=false (push not configured in env).

steps.expected: Subscription count increases, re-subscribe deduplicates, unsubscribe removes
steps.observed: API behavior validated (200 responses; count 1 -> 1 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0), but this does not satisfy VAPID-required delivery assertions.

assertions.issues: Blocked for full contract coverage because WEB_PUSH_VAPID is not configured (capabilities.push=false), so delivered-push click behavior and 404/410 stale-prune behavior could not be validated end-to-end.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: Push capability disabled in active env (capabilities.push=false), preventing end-to-end VAPID-based delivery validation.

frictions.description: Scheduled cron validation requires 6-field cron syntax (seconds included). Initial 5-field payloads failed with "Invalid cron expression, expected 6 fields".
frictions.resolution: Retested create/edit flows with 6-field cron expressions (e.g., "0 */15 * * * *").

frictions.description: Browser login attempts during UI evidence capture triggered 429 auth throttle and prevented authenticated settings-page interaction in that pass.
frictions.resolution: Captured browser evidence for the blocked state and relied on authenticated API evidence for assertion coverage where applicable.

blockers.description: Push notifications are not configured on dev rail (capabilities.push=false; no VAPID public/private keys exposed to schedules capability matrix).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Executed API subscribe/resubscribe/unsubscribe lifecycle checks to validate persistence portions, but full delivery/click contract remains untestable without VAPID-enabled push delivery.

summary: Tested 5 assigned assertions on dev rail: 4 passed (VAL-SCHED-001/002/003/004), 0 failed, 1 blocked (VAL-SCHED-009 due push capability disabled and no end-to-end VAPID delivery path).
